
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Johny-zhao/p/23162864" title="发布于 2026-09-29 23:37">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">FreeRADIUS + 华为AC/AP + 802.1X/WPA2-Enterprise 无线认证对接部署完整指南</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本指南部署<span style="font-family: 等线">方案，按</span><span style="font-family: 等线">“规划 → FreeRADIUS部署 → 华为AC/AP配置 → 终端接入 → AP纳管 → 验证排错 → 生产进阶”的顺序展开。华为AP通过CAPWAP上联AC，由AC作为RADIUS客户端（NAS）与FreeRADIUS交互，AP本身不直接与RADIUS服务器通信。</span></p>
<p><strong>一、方案架构与规划</strong></p>
<p><strong>1.1 组网架构</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>[无线终端/STA] ←无线→ [Fit AP] ←CAPWAP→ [华为AC (认证者/NAS)] ←RADIUS→ [FreeRADIUS服务器]</p>
<ul>
<li>· <strong>STA（终端）</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Supplicant角色，发起802.1X认证</li>
<li>· <strong>AP/AC</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Authenticator角色，AP通过CAPWAP注册到AC，AC将EAP报文封装为RADIUS消息转发给服务器</li>
<li>· <strong>FreeRADIUS</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Authentication Server，验证用户身份并返回授权结果</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>1.2 角色与设备对照</strong></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>角色</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">设备</span>/软件</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>作用</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>认证服务器</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>Ubuntu + FreeRADIUS</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">接收</span>RADIUS认证/计费请求，返回Accept/Reject</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">认证点</span>/NAS</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">华为</span>AC</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">接收终端</span>802.1X请求，转发给FreeRADIUS</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>无线接入</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">华为</span>AP</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">通过</span>CAPWAP注册到AC，提供SSID</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>终端</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">笔记本</span>/手机</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">通过</span>WPA2-Enterprise + 802.1X接入</p>
</td>
</tr>

</table>

<p><strong>服务器硬件建议</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>2核CPU及以上，2GB以上内存，操作系统推荐Ubuntu 20.04/22.04 LTS。需开放UDP 1812和1813端口。</p>
<p><strong>1.4 认证协议选型建议</strong></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>EAP方法</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>适用场景</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>特点</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>PEAP-MSCHAPv2</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">通用场景，对接</span>AD/LDAP账号</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">部署成本低，服务端证书</span>+账号口令</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>EAP-TLS</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>高安全场景，公司自有终端</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>双向证书认证，抗钓鱼能力最强</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>EAP-TTLS</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>对接老旧目录系统</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">隧道内可用</span>PAP承载</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>本方案以<strong>PEAP-MSCHAPv2</strong>为主要认证方式，兼顾安全性与部署便利性。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">二、</span>FreeRADIUS服务器部署</strong></p>
<p><strong>2.1 安装FreeRADIUS</strong></p>
<p><strong>Ubuntu/Debian系统：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo apt update</p>
<p>sudo apt install -y freeradius freeradius-utils freeradius-common</p>
<p><strong>CentOS/RHEL/Rocky Linux系统：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo dnf install -y freeradius freeradius-utils</p>
<p>安装完成后验证版本：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>radiusd -v</p>
<p><strong>2.2 基本配置自检</strong></p>
<p>修改配置前先执行配置检查：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>radiusd -XC</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">预期输出应包含</span><span style="font-family: 等线">“Configuration appears to be OK”。</span></p>
<p><strong>2.3 配置RADIUS客户端（NAS）</strong></p>
<p>编辑客户端配置文件：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo nano /etc/freeradius/3.0/clients.conf</p>
<p><em># CentOS路径为 /etc/raddb/clients.conf</em></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">添加华为</span>AC的客户端条目：</p>
<p>conf</p>
<p>client huawei-ac {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ipaddr = 10.23.100.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;secret = Radius@2026!Secure</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;shortname = huawei-ac</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nastype = other</p>
<p>}</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">如果</span>AC有多个源地址，可按网段添加：</p>
<p>conf</p>
<p>client huawei-ac-subnet {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ipaddr = 10.23.103.0/24</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;secret = Radius@2026!Secure</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;shortname = huawei-ac-net</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nastype = other</p>
<p>}</p>
<p><strong>注意</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>secret必须与后续华为AC上配置的radius-server shared-key完全一致。</p>
<p><strong>2.4 生成TLS证书</strong></p>
<p>PEAP认证需要服务端证书。进入证书目录生成CA和服务器证书：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>cd /etc/freeradius/3.0/certs</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 删除旧的测试证书</em></p>
<p>rm -f *.pem *.der *.csr *.crt *.key *.pl2 serial* index.txt*</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 生成CA根证书（有效期10年）</em></p>
<p>openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;-keyout ca.key -out ca.crt \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;-subj "/C=CN/O=YourCompany/CN=YourCompany-RADIUS-CA"</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 生成RADIUS服务器证书</em></p>
<p>openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout server.key -out server.csr \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;-subj "/C=CN/O=YourCompany/CN=radius.yourdomain.internal"</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>openssl x509 -req -in server.csr -CA ca.crt -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial \</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;-out server.crt -days 825 -sha256</p>
<p><strong>关键提示</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：服务器证书的</span>CN或SAN字段必须与终端连接时使用的地址匹配，否则终端会因证书校验失败而拒绝连接。如果需要通过IP地址连接，需在证书的SAN字段中包含该IP地址。FreeRADIUS也支持使用其内置的Makefile方式生成证书：编辑ca.cnf和server.cnf后执行make ca.pem和make server.pem即可。</p>
<p><strong>2.5 配置EAP模块</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">编辑</span>EAP模块配置文件：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo nano /etc/freeradius/3.0/mods-available/eap</p>
<p>确保以下关键配置正确：</p>
<p>conf</p>
<p>eap {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;default_eap_type = peap</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;timer_expire = 60</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ignore_unknown_eap_types = no</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cisco_accounting_username_bug = no</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;tls-config tls-common {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;private_key_file = ${certdir}/server.key</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;certificate_file = ${certdir}/server.crt</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ca_file = ${certdir}/ca.crt</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dh_file = ${certdir}/dh</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;random_file = /dev/urandom</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ca_path = ${cadir}</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cipher_list = "DEFAULT"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;tls_min_version = "1.2"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;peap {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;tls = tls-common</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;default_eap_type = mschapv2</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;mschapv2 {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 如果对接AD，需配置ntlm_auth</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</p>
<p>}</p>
<p><strong>2.6 配置用户账号</strong></p>
<p><strong>方式一：本地文件认证（测试环境）</strong></p>
<p>编辑用户文件：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo nano /etc/freeradius/3.0/mods-config/files/authorize</p>
<p>添加测试用户：</p>
<p>conf</p>
<p>testuser &nbsp;Cleartext-Password := "Test@1234"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Service-Type = Framed-User,</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Reply-Message := "Welcome, %{User-Name}"</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">方式二：</span>MySQL数据库认证（生产环境）</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">安装</span>MySQL模块后，在mods-available/sql中配置数据库连接信息，并将用户数据存储在radcheck、radreply等标准表中。需将mods-available/sql软链接到mods-enabled/目录以启用模块。</p>
<p><strong>2.7 启动服务并验证</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo systemctl enable freeradius</p>
<p>sudo systemctl start freeradius</p>
<p>sudo systemctl status freeradius</p>
<p>使用调试模式验证（建议在配置阶段使用）：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo systemctl stop freeradius</p>
<p>sudo freeradius -X</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">看到</span><span style="font-family: 等线">“Ready to process requests”表示服务正常启动。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">使用</span>radtest工具进行本地验证：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>radtest testuser Test@1234 127.0.0.1 0 testing123</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">预期输出包含</span><span style="font-family: 等线">“Access-Accept”，表示认证成功。如果返回Access-Reject，请检查clients.conf中localhost的密钥是否为testing123。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">三、华为</span>AC配置（设备纳管与认证对接）</strong></p>
<p><strong>3.1 基础网络规划</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">以下配置在华为</span>AC命令行界面完成。首先配置AP、AC和上层网络设备之间的二层互通。</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>&lt;HUAWEI&gt; system-view</p>
<p>[HUAWEI] sysname AC</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 创建VLAN</em></p>
<p>[AC] vlan batch 100 101 103</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 配置AC连接AP的接口</em></p>
<p>[AC] interface GigabitEthernet 0/0/1</p>
<p>[AC-GigabitEthernet0/0/1] port link-type trunk</p>
<p>[AC-GigabitEthernet0/0/1] port trunk pvid vlan 100</p>
<p>[AC-GigabitEthernet0/0/1] port trunk allow-pass vlan 100 101</p>
<p>[AC-GigabitEthernet0/0/1] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 配置管理VLAN接口（AP管理）</em></p>
<p>[AC] interface Vlanif 100</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif100] ip address 10.23.100.1 24</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif100] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 配置业务VLAN接口</em></p>
<p>[AC] interface Vlanif 101</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif101] ip address 10.23.101.1 24</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif101] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 配置AC与RADIUS通信VLAN接口</em></p>
<p>[AC] interface Vlanif 103</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif103] ip address 10.23.103.254 24</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif103] quit</p>
<p><strong>3.2 配置DHCP服务器</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] dhcp enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># AP地址池（接口地址池方式）</em></p>
<p>[AC] interface Vlanif 100</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif100] dhcp select interface</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif100] dhcp server dns-list 8.8.8.8</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif100] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># STA地址池</em></p>
<p>[AC] interface Vlanif 101</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif101] dhcp select interface</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif101] dhcp server dns-list 8.8.8.8</p>
<p>[AC-Vlanif101] quit</p>
<p><strong>3.3 配置RADIUS服务器模板</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">创建</span>RADIUS服务器模板，指定FreeRADIUS服务器的IP、端口和共享密钥：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] radius-server template freeradius-1</p>
<p>[AC-radius-freeradius-1] radius-server authentication 10.23.103.1 1812</p>
<p>[AC-radius-freeradius-1] radius-server accounting 10.23.103.1 1813</p>
<p>[AC-radius-freeradius-1] radius-server shared-key cipher Radius@2026!Secure</p>
<p>[AC-radius-freeradius-1] radius-server retransmit 2</p>
<p>[AC-radius-freeradius-1] radius-server source ip-address 10.23.103.254</p>
<p>[AC-radius-freeradius-1] quit</p>
<p><strong>参数说明</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>radius-server source ip-address用于指定AC向RADIUS服务器发送请求时的源IP地址，确保FreeRADIUS的clients.conf中配置的IP与该源IP一致。</p>
<p><strong>3.4 配置AAA认证方案</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] aaa</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 创建认证方案</em></p>
<p>[AC-aaa] authentication-scheme wlan-auth</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-authen-wlan-auth] authentication-mode radius</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-authen-wlan-auth] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 创建计费方案</em></p>
<p>[AC-aaa] accounting-scheme wlan-acct</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-accounting-wlan-acct] accounting-mode radius</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-accounting-wlan-acct] accounting realtime 15</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-accounting-wlan-acct] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 创建认证域并绑定方案和服务器模板</em></p>
<p>[AC-aaa] domain example.com</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-domain-example.com] authentication-scheme wlan-auth</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-domain-example.com] accounting-scheme wlan-acct</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-domain-example.com] radius-server freeradius-1</p>
<p>[AC-aaa-domain-example.com] quit</p>
<p>[AC-aaa] quit</p>
<p>accounting realtime 15表示每15分钟上报一次计费信息，便于后续审计和在线用户统计。</p>
<p><strong>3.5 配置802.1X接入模板和认证模板</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p><em># 创建802.1X接入模板</em></p>
<p>[AC] dot1x-access-profile name wlan-dot1x</p>
<p>[AC-dot1x-access-profile-wlan-dot1x] dot1x authentication-method eap</p>
<p>[AC-dot1x-access-profile-wlan-dot1x] quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 创建认证模板，绑定802.1X接入模板和认证域</em></p>
<p>[AC] authentication-profile name wlan-auth-profile</p>
<p>[AC-authentication-profile-wlan-auth-profile] dot1x-access-profile wlan-dot1x</p>
<p>[AC-authentication-profile-wlan-auth-profile] access-domain example.com force</p>
<p>[AC-authentication-profile-wlan-auth-profile] quit</p>
<p>AC作为EAP中继模式，将终端的EAP报文转发给RADIUS服务器处理，兼容EAP-PEAP、EAP-TLS等多种认证方式。</p>
<p><strong>3.6 测试AC与RADIUS服务器连通性</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span>AAA视图下使用测试命令验证AC与FreeRADIUS的通信：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] aaa</p>
<p>[AC-aaa] test-aaa testuser Test@1234 radius-template freeradius-1</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">预期输出：</span>Info: Account test succeed.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">如果测试失败，请检查：</span>AC与FreeRADIUS服务器之间路由是否可达；共享密钥是否一致；FreeRADIUS的clients.conf中是否已添加AC的源IP；防火墙是否放行UDP 1812/1813。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">四、</span>WLAN业务配置（AP纳管与无线接入）</strong></p>
<p><strong>4.1 配置AP上线认证模式</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] wlan</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] ap auth-mode mac-auth</p>
<p><strong>4.2 手动添加AP</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] ap-id 1</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-1] ap-mac 00e0-fc12-3456</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-1] ap-name AP-Floor1-01</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-1] ap-group default</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-1] quit</p>
<p>AP上电后通过DHCP获取IP地址，然后通过CAPWAP协议自动发现AC并上线。可以通过display ap all命令查看AP上线状态，确认AP状态为normal。</p>
<p><strong>4.3 配置SSID模板</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] ssid-profile name corp-ssid</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ssid-prof-corp-ssid] ssid Corp-WiFi</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ssid-prof-corp-ssid] quit</p>
<p><strong>4.4 配置安全模板（WPA2-802.1X-AES）</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] security-profile name corp-sec</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-sec-prof-corp-sec] security wpa2 dot1x aes</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-sec-prof-corp-sec] quit</p>
<p><strong>4.5 配置VAP模板并绑定所有模板</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] vap-profile name corp-vap</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-vap-prof-corp-vap] forward-mode tunnel</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-vap-prof-corp-vap] service-vlan vlan-id 101</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-vap-prof-corp-vap] ssid-profile corp-ssid</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-vap-prof-corp-vap] security-profile corp-sec</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-vap-prof-corp-vap] authentication-profile wlan-auth-profile</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-vap-prof-corp-vap] quit</p>
<p><strong>关键步骤</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>VAP模板需绑定SSID模板、安全模板和认证模板，确保无线用户接入时触发802.1X认证。forward-mode tunnel表示隧道转发模式，数据流量经CAPWAP隧道集中到AC转发。</p>
<p><strong>4.6 将VAP模板应用到AP组</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] ap-group name default</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default] radio 0</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default-radio-0] vap-profile corp-vap wlan 1</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default-radio-0] quit</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default] radio 1</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default-radio-1] vap-profile corp-vap wlan 1</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default-radio-1] quit</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-ap-group-default] quit</p>
<p>[AC-wlan-view] quit</p>
<p><strong>4.7 保存配置</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] save</p>
<p><strong>五、认证测试与验证</strong></p>
<p><strong>5.1 FreeRADIUS端验证</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span>FreeRADIUS服务器上启动调试模式，实时观察认证过程：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo systemctl stop freeradius</p>
<p>sudo freeradius -X</p>
<p><strong>5.2 终端连接测试</strong></p>
<p><strong>Windows终端</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">连接</span>SSID Corp-WiFi：</p>
<p>1. <span style="font-family: 等线">选择</span>WPA2-企业或WPA3-企业</p>
<p>2. <span style="font-family: 等线">安全类型选择</span>WPA2-企业</p>
<p>3. <span style="font-family: 等线">加密类型选择</span>AES</p>
<p>4. <span style="font-family: 等线">认证方式选择</span>PEAP</p>
<p>5. <span style="font-family: 等线">内部认证选择</span>MS-CHAPv2</p>
<p>6. <span style="font-family: 等线">输入账号</span>testuser，密码Test@1234</p>
<p>7. 如果服务器使用自签名证书，首次连接需确认证书</p>
<p><strong>Android终端</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">类似设置：</span>EAP方法选择PEAP，阶段2认证选择MSCHAPV2。</p>
<p><strong>5.3 认证成功验证</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span>FreeRADIUS调试输出中，应看到以下关键日志：</p>
<p>text</p>
<p>(0) Received Access-Request Id 0 from 10.23.103.254:xxxxx</p>
<p>(0) &nbsp;&nbsp;User-Name = "testuser"</p>
<p>(0) Sent Access-Challenge Id 0</p>
<p>...</p>
<p>(0) Sent Access-Accept Id 1</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span>AC上验证在线用户：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>[AC] display access-user access-type dot1x</p>
<p>[AC] display dot1x</p>
<p><strong>5.4 使用eapol_test工具测试</strong></p>
<p>eapol_test是wpa_supplicant提供的802.1X认证测试工具，可以在服务器端模拟完整的EAP认证过程，无需真实终端即可验证PEAP认证链路是否正常。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">安装方式一（</span>Ubuntu包管理器）：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo apt install eapoltest</p>
<p><strong>安装方式二（从源码编译）：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo apt install -y git make gcc libssl-dev</p>
<p>git clone https://github.com/krisarmstrong/eap-test-suite.git</p>
<p>cd eap-test-suite</p>
<p>python3 -m venv .venv &amp;&amp; source .venv/bin/activate</p>
<p>pip install -e .</p>
<p><em># 脚本会自动编译eapol_test并安装依赖</em></p>
<p><strong>配置测试文件</strong>peap-test.conf<strong>：</strong></p>
<p>conf</p>
<p>network={</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ssid="Corp-WiFi"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;key_mgmt=WPA-EAP</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;eap=PEAP</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;identity="testuser"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;password="Test@1234"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;phase1="peaplabel=0"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;phase2="auth=MSCHAPV2"</p>
<p>}</p>
<p><strong>执行测试：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>eapol_test -c peap-test.conf -s Radius@2026!Secure -a 10.23.103.1 -p 1812</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">该工具会输出完整的认证过程日志，包括</span>EAP方法协商、TLS握手和最终认证结果（Access-Accept或Access-Reject）。</p>
<p><strong>六、常见问题排查</strong></p>
<p><strong>6.1 认证失败排查步骤</strong></p>
<p><strong>AC侧排查：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p><em># 查看用户上线失败记录</em></p>
<p>[AC] display aaa online-fail-record mac-address xxxx-xxxx-xxxx</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 查看802.1X认证信息</em></p>
<p>[AC] display dot1x</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 查看在线用户信息</em></p>
<p>[AC] display access-user</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 查看RADIUS服务器模板状态</em></p>
<p>[AC] display radius-server template freeradius-1</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 实时调试RADIUS交互（生产环境谨慎使用）</em></p>
<p>[AC] debug radius all</p>
<p>[AC] terminal debugging</p>
<p>display aaa online-fail-record mac-address H-H-H命令可查看STA上线失败记录，输出中的User online fail reason字段会显示具体失败原因。</p>
<p><strong>FreeRADIUS侧排查：</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">使用</span>freeradius -X调试模式启动，观察完整的RADIUS报文交互过程。重点检查是否收到Access-Request、证书是否加载成功、用户是否在authorize文件中匹配到、EAP认证流程是否完整。</p>
<p><strong>网络侧排查：</strong></p>
<p>bash</p>
<p><em># 在FreeRADIUS服务器上抓包</em></p>
<p>sudo tcpdump -i eth0 udp port 1812 -vv</p>
<p>sudo tcpdump -i eth0 udp port 1813 -vv</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">确认</span>AC是否向FreeRADIUS发送了Access-Request。</p>

<p><strong>6.3 认证排错常用工具</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <strong>AC侧</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>display aaa online-fail-record、display dot1x、trace object mac-address、debug radius all</li>
<li>· <strong>FreeRADIUS侧</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>freeradius -X（调试模式）、radtest（本地测试）、eapol_test（EAP测试）</li>
<li>· <strong>网络层</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>ping、traceroute验证AC与RADIUS服务器之间路由可达；tcpdump抓包确认报文交互</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>七、生产环境优化与进阶配置</strong></p>
<p><strong>7.1 基础优化建议</strong></p>
<p>1. <strong>共享密钥复杂化</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：避免使用</span>testing123、admin123等弱密钥，使用包含大小写字母、数字和特殊字符的强密钥。</p>
<p>2. <strong>证书规范化</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：生产环境建议使用企业</span>CA签发的证书，确保证书CN/SAN与终端访问的地址匹配，避免终端频繁确认证书。</p>
<p>3. <strong>防火墙放行</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：确保</span>AC到FreeRADIUS的UDP 1812、1813可达。</p>
<p>4. <strong>日志轮转</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：启用</span>FreeRADIUS日志轮转策略，防止日志文件过大。</p>
<p>5. <strong>监控告警</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：配置对</span>FreeRADIUS服务状态和认证成功率的监控。</p>
<p>6. <strong>定期备份</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：备份</span>FreeRADIUS的配置文件和证书。</p>
<p>7. <strong>安全加固</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：生产环境中关闭调试模式，限制客户端</span>IP访问范围。</p>
<p>8. <strong>高可用部署</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在</span>AC上配置主备RADIUS服务器模板，提高认证可用性。</p>
<p><strong>7.2 动态VLAN下发</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">通过</span>FreeRADIUS在Access-Accept报文中下发VLAN属性，实现按用户组分配业务VLAN，按部门隔离网络流量。</p>
<p><strong>RADIUS属性要求</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：动态</span>VLAN下发必须同时使用以下三个标准RADIUS属性，缺一不可：</p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>属性</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>属性号</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>必须设置的值</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>说明</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Tunnel-Type</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>064</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>13</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">表示</span>VLAN类型</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Tunnel-Medium-Type</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>065</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>6</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">表示</span>IEEE-802介质</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Tunnel-Private-Group-ID</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>081</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>VLAN ID</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">目标</span>VLAN编号</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>FreeRADIUS用户文件配置示例</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span>mods-config/files/authorize）：</p>
<p>conf</p>
<p># 财务部用户 → VLAN 101</p>
<p>user_finance &nbsp;Cleartext-Password := "Fin@2026"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Tunnel-Type = VLAN,</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Tunnel-Medium-Type = IEEE-802,</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Tunnel-Private-Group-Id = 101</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 技术部用户 → VLAN 102</p>
<p>user_tech &nbsp;Cleartext-Password := "Tech@2026"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Tunnel-Type = VLAN,</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Tunnel-Medium-Type = IEEE-802,</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Tunnel-Private-Group-Id = 102</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">华为</span>AC侧</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>AC收到Access-Accept报文后，会自动解析上述三个属性并将用户动态切换到指定VLAN。需注意AC上必须已创建对应的VLAN，否则VLAN授权将失效。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">基于</span>LDAP组的动态VLAN</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：结合</span>LDAP模块，可以利用LDAP-Group实现按用户角色自动分配VLAN。例如通过if条件判断用户所属组并返回不同的Tunnel-Private-Group-Id值，从而实现不同角色的权限分离。</p>
<p><strong>7.3 AD/LDAP对接</strong></p>
<p>使用企业目录账号替代本地用户文件，实现统一认证管理。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">启用</span>LDAP模块</strong>：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p>sudo ln -s /etc/freeradius/3.0/mods-available/ldap /etc/freeradius/3.0/mods-enabled/ldap</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">编辑</span>LDAP模块配置</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span>mods-enabled/ldap）：</p>
<p>conf</p>
<p>ldap {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;server = "ad.example.com"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;port = 389</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;identity = "cn=radius-bind,ou=ServiceAccounts,dc=example,dc=com"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;password = "BindPassword"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;base_dn = "dc=example,dc=com"</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;user {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;base_dn = "ou=Users,${..base_dn}"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;filter = "(sAMAccountName=%{%{Stripped-User-Name}:-%{User-Name}})"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;scope = sub</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;group {</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;base_dn = "ou=Groups,${..base_dn}"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;filter = "(objectClass=group)"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;scope = sub</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;name_attribute = cn</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;membership_filter = "(|(member=%{control:Ldap-UserDn})(memberUid=%{%{Stripped-User-Name}:-%{User-Name}}))"</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}</p>
<p>}</p>
<p><strong>说明</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在</span>Microsoft Active Directory环境中，建议使用rlm_winbind进行认证，使用rlm_ldap进行组成员资格检查，因为winbind协议不支持LDAP可用的完整组检查范围。如果使用Samba的ntlm_auth对接AD，在mods-available/mschap中配置ntlm_auth路径即可。</p>
<p><strong>在</strong>authorize<strong>和</strong>authenticate<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">部分启用</span>LDAP</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：编辑</span>sites-available/default，在authorize部分的eap之后添加ldap，在authenticate部分按需添加。</p>
<p><strong>7.4 日志纳管与后续对接</strong></p>
<p>1. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">日志接入</span>SIEM/监控平台</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：将</span>FreeRADIUS日志接入ELK、Graylog或现有监控告警平台。</p>
<p>2. <strong>关键字告警</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对</span>radius.log做关键字告警，例如Reject、Ignoring request、malformed packet。</p>
<p>3. <strong>计费数据统计</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：通过</span>RADIUS Accounting统计在线用户数、上下线时间、流量。</p>
<p>4. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">多</span>AC管理</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：如果有多台</span>AC，在FreeRADIUS的clients.conf中逐个添加AC的IP或网段。</p>
<p>5. <strong>性能优化</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对于大规模部署，考虑启用</span>MySQL后端存储用户数据，并配置FreeRADIUS缓存策略。</p>
<p><strong>7.5 eapol_test自动化测试</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">利用前文安装的</span>eap-test-suite工具，可实现自动化EAP认证测试：</p>
<p>bash</p>
<p><em># 测试PEAP认证</em></p>
<p>python3 -m eap_test_suite.cli --eap PEAP</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em># 启用调试模式</em></p>
<p>python3 -m eap_test_suite.cli --debug</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">编辑</span>config/config.json可配置RADIUS服务器地址、端口、共享密钥和测试凭据，方便批量回归测试。</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">本指南覆盖了从</span>FreeRADIUS安装配置、华为AC/AP对接、无线用户802.1X认证到AP上线纳管、在线用户验证、动态VLAN下发和AD/LDAP对接的完整流程。实际部署时，请将示例IP、VLAN、密钥、SSID和域名替换为现网规划值。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
